codes.meaning: A stream message of a type this receiver does not handle yet; in 1.1 every record, principal, group, membership and permission message.
No component on the site answers this job's kind for this source.
The other side did not answer in time: a component past the job's deadline, or Knovas when Link called it.
The job is no longer the caller's: its lease ended or it has an outcome already; the late part or result is discarded and counted.
The original could not be fetched: no component answered before the deadline, or the source did not answer.
The site or the source refused to hand out the original; the component's own code says why.
The document has no source reference, so its original cannot be located.
The item is not in the source, or not at the requested version.
The item changed in the source since the expected version; nothing was written.
The write's mode is not accepted; only proposal is, until autonomous agents exist.
The component's credential for the source lacks the rights a write needs (GitHub: contents and pull requests write).
Fetching originals is switched off for this source.
Writing back is switched off for this source.
The mapping's writes section does not name this fact.
The attribute is computed from other data and is never written.
The value breaks the source's own rule for the field (length, allowed values, date).
The fact is built by an expression that cannot be turned back into one field of the source.
The write names a mapping that the component's package does not hold.
The same change to this node was rejected before; a rejection is a tombstone.
Knovas Link has no certificate yet: it runs its control plane but claims no job and writes nothing to the tenant.
The Brain route is not on Knovas Link's relay allow-list.
Knovas Link received a job that does not validate against the contract; it is never handed to a component.
Knovas did not take a part of a fetch; the relay of that job ends.
Knovas Link has no key yet because it has not enrolled; its certificate cannot be requested or installed before it has.
install-certificate was given no PEM certificate; nothing was written.
The certificate is not for Knovas Link's stored key, for example one signed from another request or before a new enrolment; nothing was written.
The certificate has expired or is not valid yet by the site's clock; nothing was written.
The certificate is not issued for client authentication (extended key usage clientAuth); nothing was written.
The original is larger than the fetch's max_bytes; nothing was sent.
The fetched bytes' git blob hash differs from the requested version; nothing was sent.
The component cannot write back into this kind of file or this key, for example a nested key or a value that is not one scalar.
The file has no front matter block to write the value into.
The edits leave the file exactly as it is; nothing was staged.
GitHub refused the call because the credential's rate limit is used up.
A write's branch was left in the repository without a pull request; remove it or open the pull request by hand.
A write's branch name is taken by another change; it is never overwritten or deleted.
The component did not reach GitHub.
The source's repository or branch is not valid, or not visible to the credential.
GitHub answered in a shape the component does not expect.
A write into a source that reads a tag or a commit; a pull request needs a branch.
The compiled change does not name the job's item and version, or holds no edit.
A job field is outside what the component accepts, for example a fetch's max_bytes.
The component failed on a job for a reason of its own; its log has the error type.
